disclosure: New fixed stories created before evaluation. No model/ranker fitting or language-specific repairs are permitted after seeing these results. Familiar lexical scaffolding is not free-language generalization. Failures remain in the denominator.

mode_definitions.full: Unchanged inference with attention, source archive and revision.
mode_definitions.no_attention: Evaluation-only replacement of AttentionState.process with a valid zero-work trace; remember, parser, context, world, revision rules and all weights remain unchanged.
mode_definitions.no_archive: Evaluation-only eviction of all previously archived source records immediately before each process call; normal current-turn remember, parser, context, world and all weights remain unchanged.
mode_definitions.no_agreement: Evaluation-only replacement of attention.exchange with its initial root sets; no links propagate provenance. Encoder, selection and all weights remain unchanged.
mode_definitions.no_duplicate: Evaluation-only replacement of attention.EvidenceLedger.observe: each completed read gets its own row instead of coalescing a root. Repeat-tagged row IDs index repeated reads, not real independent witnesses. No scoring or candidate-selection rule is replaced.

mechanism_observations.agreement: Measure synchronous provenance exchange and ordering invariance separately. Current exchange output is not an input to constrained_choice; no causal language gain is presumed.
mechanism_observations.duplicate: Measure unique provenance roots under copied/re-read features separately. No fictitious vote-counting replacement is presented as an ablation.

disclosure_harness_recheck: Initial 68 results retained. Only evaluator adapter/oracle implementation corrected; production code, model, ranker and frozen scenario manifest unchanged. S01/L12 rechecked (6 jobs). Both original and corrected results are published.
